themes.title: Coverage and copay are unclear until late in the booking
themes.description: Participants wanted to know up front whether a provider takes their insurance and what the visit would cost, and left the app to check their insurer's portal.
themes.opportunity: Show in-network status and an estimated copay on each provider card.
themes.effortNote: Requires an insurance eligibility integration and copay estimates.

quotes.text: The copay estimate is nowhere until the last step.
Show me what’s covered before I start booking.

themes.title: Reminders help participants feel prepared
themes.description: Participants said the text reminder before the visit made them confident they would not forget it.
themes.opportunity: Extend reminders with directions and a preparation checklist.
themes.effortNote: Extends the existing reminder messages with extra content.

quotes.text: The reminder with directions saved me a stressful morning.
The text reminder the day before is why I did not forget.

themes.title: Moving an appointment means calling the clinic
themes.description: Participants could not reschedule or cancel in the app and had to phone the clinic during office hours.
themes.opportunity: Add self-serve reschedule and cancel with clear change windows.
themes.effortNote: Self-serve changes need clinic scheduling rules and notifications.

quotes.text: I had to call the office and wait on hold just to move my visit.
Cancelling should not need a phone call during office hours.

themes.title: Finding open appointment times across providers takes too many steps
themes.description: Participants could not tell who was free this week from the results list and had to open each provider's profile one at a time to look for an opening.
themes.opportunity: Show open times for each provider in search results, with a combined calendar view.
themes.effortNote: Needs a combined availability feed across providers and a calendar view in search.

quotes.text: Gave up and called the clinic because the calendar never loaded.
